status: Task completed successfully. All requirements met: vectorops 0.1.0 package created with dotproduct function, built and distributed, PyPI server running on port 8080, package installable via pip with --index-url, and test assertion passes.

knowledge.content: Required function: dotproduct(list1, list2) - takes two lists of numbers (floats/ints) and returns their dot product. Must be in __init__.py at root level for direct import: `from vectorops import dotproduct`
Test case for dotproduct: assert 1 == dotproduct([1,1], [0,1]) must pass
Must set up local PyPI server on port 8080 that hosts the vectorops package
Final verification: pip install --index-url http://localhost:8080/simple vectorops==0.1.0 must work successfully
Package distribution files built at: dist/vectorops-0.1.0-py3-none-any.whl (wheel) and dist/vectorops-0.1.0.tar.gz (source distribution)

procedural.content: dotproduct implementation uses: return sum(x * y for x, y in zip(vec1, vec2)) - this correctly calculates dot product and will pass the test case assert 1 == dotproduct([1,1], [0,1])

Package successfully built using `python setup.py sdist bdist_wheel` which created both dist/vectorops-0.1.0-py3-none-any.whl (wheel) and dist/vectorops-0.1.0.tar.gz (tarball). pypiserver installed successfully with `pip install pypiserver -q`

PyPI server started successfully using `nohup pypi-server run -p 8080 dist/ > pypi_server.log 2>&1 &` with PID saved to pypi_server.pid. The `ps` command is not available in this environment, but the server start command completed without error.
PyPI server verified accessible at http://localhost:8080/ - curl response shows "Welcome to pypiserver!" and confirms it's serving 2 packages (the wheel and tarball distributions)

Package index verified accessible: curl to http://localhost:8080/simple/vectorops/ shows both vectorops-0.1.0-py3-none-any.whl and vectorops-0.1.0.tar.gz are available with SHA256 hashes, confirming the server is correctly serving the package files

Package installation successful: `pip install --index-url http://localhost:8080/simple vectorops==0.1.0 --no-cache-dir -q` completed with exit code 0, confirming the package can be installed from the local PyPI server as required

Final verification successful: Package installed from local PyPI server and dotproduct([1,1], [0,1]) correctly returns 1, passing the required assertion test. The complete workflow (build → serve → install → test) works end-to-end.
